subject: Mobile Development
title: The Race Between Motorola and Bell Labs
description: Learn The Race Between Motorola and Bell Labs in one minute.

hook.text: Two rivals spent decades racing to build the first handheld mobile phone.

buildup.text: Bell Labs had the cellular network patents. Motorola had the hardware engineering.

discovery.text: Motorola won the handset race. Cooper's 1973 call beat Bell Labs to the punch.

twist.text: Bell Labs' parent AT&T built the network that all mobile phones would eventually use.

climax.text: Neither company could have succeeded alone. The phone needed the network and vice versa.

punchline.text: The rival built the road; Motorola built the car.

quiz.question: Which company made the first handheld mobile phone?
